title: PGR Lab
summary: Website of the Plant Genome Regulation Lab at UNAB, part of the PhytoLearning Millennium Nucleus: research lines, team, publications and tools — with living ASCII motifs.

title: WIP: AgroShield
summary: A carrier board for low-power agricultural sensing, part of the AgroPhy project: sockets for a Seeed XIAO nRF52840 and a LoRa module, four Watermark soil-moisture inputs, a temperature probe, and battery plus solar power. Designed in KiCad; the routed layout is under review and nothing has been manufactured yet.

thumb.alt: 3D render of the AgroShield circuit board spinning on one of its corners

title: When was each gene born?
summary: Phylostratigraphy of 27,420 Arabidopsis genes using Ensembl Compara, turned into an interactive web piece with sound.

title: CDapp
summary: A web app that uses generative AI to analyse crop data, built with Gemini and React.

title: Phytoboard
summary: A dashboard for monitoring phytosanitary data in real time, built with React and TypeScript.
